Hi Lena — thanks for the clear asks. I put together a concise rollout plan and owners below, and attached an integration outline you can drop inputs into. High level: discovery (1 week), prompt collection & baseline evals (2 weeks), eval harness integration + automated regression checks (2 weeks), canary + rollback policy & ops (1 week), and final validation + handoff (1 week). Total: 6–7 weeks with prompt responsiveness.

Phases & owners:
- Discovery (Diego): align SLOs, traffic slices, and validation criteria.
- Prompt set collection (Marissa): CS coordinates prompt harvesting + sample labels from HealthBridge SMEs. Use prompt_set_template.csv.
- Eval harness integration (Implementation team / Lauren): hook HealthBridge evals into our harness; define automated regression tests and thresholds.
- Canary & rollback policy (Diego + Lauren): define canary traffic %, rollback triggers (metric delta & confidence), and automated fallback to previous model variant.
- Alerts & runbook (Marissa): configure regression alerting into your PagerDuty/Slack channel and provide runbook steps.

Deliverables we need from HealthBridge:
- 500–1,000 representative prompts (CSV) and a small labeled ground-truth set (50–100 items)
- Target SLOs for latency and quality (precision/recall or custom metric)
- Stakeholder contact for escalation (procurement already looped)

Canary + rollback sketch:
- Canary traffic ramp 1% -> 5% -> 15% over 48h windows with automated metric checks at each step.
- Alerting thresholds: primary quality metric drop >3% with p<0.05, or latency spike >2x baseline -> automatic pause of ramp and Slack + PagerDuty alert.
- Rollback: automatic route to previous stable model variant and create a regression ticket in JIRA (INF-9832).

Attachments:
- qmon-integration-outline.xlsx (spreadsheet): includes phase checklist, templates, and the prompt_set_template.csv reference.

Next steps:
1) Marissa to own prompt collection and share the CSV by EOD next Tue.
2) Lauren to confirm availability for eval harness connection (we estimate 4 dev days).
3) Schedule a 60min kickoff next week to align on owners and the drive folder.

If this looks good I will send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference
